query: SELECT wakeup_id FROM wakeup_definitions WHERE authority='local' AND wakeup_status IN ('active','paused') AND json_extract(definition_json,'$.message.target.endpoint.serviceId')=json_extract(?,'$.endpoint.serviceId') AND json_extract(definition_json,'$.message.target.endpoint.endpointId')=json_extract(?,'$.endpoint.endpointId') AND json_extract(definition_json,'$.message.target.sessionId')=json_extract(?,'$.sessionId') LIMIT 1
